1.consolidated_definition: Improvisación musical que surge del encuentro entre dos o más músicos. Era algo improvisado. Poco a poco fuimos dándole estructura y demás, pero al inicio era un jammeo y ya. Estábamos divirtiéndonos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Improvisational musical performance arising from the encounter between two or more musicians. It was something improvised initially. Gradually, we were giving it structure and so on, but at first, it was a jam session and that's it. We were having fun.
